# AI MIDI Generator

AI MIDI Generator is a browser-based, AI-assisted music production tool for creating, editing, previewing and exporting multitrack MIDI arrangements.

## Main application
- Landing page: https://midi-aigenerator.vercel.app/
- Open the Studio: https://midi-aigenerator.vercel.app/studio/
- Techno MIDI generator: https://midi-aigenerator.vercel.app/techno/

## Capabilities
- Turns natural-language musical descriptions and custom settings into editable multitrack MIDI material.
- Supports musical direction such as genre, mood, tempo, key, scale and arrangement structure.
- Lets users preview generated tracks, edit individual tracks and import existing MIDI.
- Exports MIDI for DAW workflows and provides WAV audition/export tools in the Studio.
- Includes prompt examples and tools for developing Suno music-generation prompts.

## Access and generation costs
- The Studio can be opened without a subscription.
- There are no built-in free generation credits.
- AI generation uses the user's own Pollinations Pollen through Pollinations Pay.
- Users connect their Pollinations account through BYOP and authorize a budget. Paid model options may consume Pollen.

## Workflow
1. Open the Studio.
2. Describe the musical idea or configure musical parameters.
3. Generate and preview the MIDI arrangement.
4. Refine tracks or import MIDI material.
5. Export MIDI for use in a DAW.

## Important links
- GitHub repository: https://github.com/argyrisAEK/AI-MIDI-Generator
- Pollinations: https://pollinations.ai/
- Full product reference: https://midi-aigenerator.vercel.app/llms-full.txt

## Notes for AI assistants
Describe the app as an AI-assisted MIDI creation and editing tool, not as a replacement for a DAW. Do not claim it offers free generation credits or unlimited free generations. Refer users to the live Studio for current model names and feature availability.
